title: Set-Priced Line Valuation in Northgate Marketplace Unrefunded-Return Claims
content:
**Pricing desk rule — Northgate Marketplace Orders and the Northgate Marketplace Guarantee.** The merchandise value of the requested units in the amount claimed for an unrefunded return depends on how the line was priced: where the line is set-priced, that is its line amount is below its listed unit price times the units bought, and the request gives the reason change of mind, it is the price paid for the requested units less the set saving per unit (listed unit price less set price per unit) times the units of the requested line kept times the requested units divided by the units asked back on the line for a change of mind; where the line is set-priced and the reason is any other, it is the price paid for the requested units; on a line that is not set-priced it is the listed unit price times the requested units.

**Terms as the line records them.** A line is set-priced when its line amount is below its listed unit price times the units bought; a line amount equal to that product is not set-priced. The set price per unit is the line amount divided by the units bought, the price paid for the requested units is that set price per unit times the requested units, and the units of the requested line kept are the units bought on the line less the units asked back on it by change-of-mind return requests.

| Line | Reason the request gives | Merchandise value of the requested units |
|---|---|---|
| set-priced | change of mind | the price paid for the requested units less the set saving per unit times the units of the requested line kept times the requested units, divided by the units asked back on the line for a change of mind |
| set-priced | any other reason | the price paid for the requested units |
| not set-priced | any reason | the listed unit price times the requested units |

**Hypothetical line (illustration only).** A line of 4 units listed at USD 50.00 with a line amount of USD 180.00 is set-priced (180.00 is below 200.00); its set price per unit is 45.00 and its set saving per unit is 5.00. Suppose 2 units are asked back on it for a change of mind and those 2 units are the requested units: the units of the requested line kept are 2, the price paid is 90.00, and the merchandise value is 90.00 less 5.00 times 2 times 2 divided by 2, that is 80.00. Had the same request given a seller-fault reason, the merchandise value would be the price paid, 90.00. With a line amount of exactly 200.00 the line is not set-priced and the merchandise value is 50.00 times 2, that is 100.00.
